streamerreplay.ffmpeg_help.title: Video export needs ffmpeg
streamerreplay.ffmpeg_help.intro: MP4 videos are made by ffmpeg, a free program. It is not installed on this PC, or Minecraft cannot find it.
streamerreplay.ffmpeg_help.steps.mac: Easiest: open Terminal and enter:  brew install ffmpeg   (needs Homebrew from brew.sh). Then come back here and click Check.
streamerreplay.ffmpeg_help.steps.linux: Install the ffmpeg package with your package manager (for example: sudo apt install ffmpeg). Then click Check.
streamerreplay.ffmpeg_help.folder: Or: open the download page, download a build (on Windows the "release essentials" .zip), unzip it and put the unzipped folder into the ffmpeg folder of your game (button below).
streamerreplay.ffmpeg_help.png: Until then, Export still works: it saves PNG images instead of a video.
streamerreplay.toast.not_recording.off: Recording is off. Turn it on in the pause menu (top left); it starts the next time you join a world.
streamerreplay.toast.disk_too_slow: The disk could not keep up, so recording stopped. Everything until now is saved.
streamerreplay.toast.cleaned_up: Old replays cleaned up: %s (older than %s days)
streamerreplay.toast.ffmpeg_installed: ffmpeg %s installed – MP4 export is ready
streamerreplay.pause_menu.recording.on.t: Recording right now. Turn it off to stop and save; nothing is recorded until you turn it back on.
streamerreplay.pause_menu.recording.next: On: recording starts the next time you join a world or server.
Off: nothing is recorded. Turn it on to record from the next time you join a world.
streamerreplay.config.recording.tooltip: What is recorded automatically from the moment you join. Recordings stay on your PC. The same switch is in the pause menu (top left).
streamerreplay.config.cleanup.tooltip: Deletes recordings after this many days so your disk does not fill up. Replays with markers or a name you gave them are always kept.
streamerreplay.config.show_chat.tooltip: Shows the recorded chat while watching. Off by default, so private messages never show up on stream. Videos never contain chat.
streamerreplay.editor.update_keyframe.to: Updates the selected keyframe with the current camera (position, direction, FOV, roll)
streamerreplay.error.ffmpeg_checksum: The download is damaged or not the expected file. Please try again.
streamerreplay.ffmpeg_help.install: One click: Install downloads ffmpeg %s (%s MB) from Gyan's GitHub page (the same build that "winget install ffmpeg" installs), checks it and puts it into .minecraft/ffmpeg. This is the only time the mod goes online, and only when you click.
streamerreplay.ffmpeg_help.manual.window: Or by hand: in PowerShell enter  winget install ffmpeg  – or unzip a build into the ffmpeg folder (buttons below).
streamerreplay.ffmpeg_help.install_butto: Downloads and checks ffmpeg; MP4 export works right after
